storage_classes.intentionally_public: Network-wide cleartext is an explicit product requirement and has been privacy-reviewed.
storage_classes.protected_shareable: Patient-linked or otherwise sensitive content must move to an encrypted shareable representation; coordinator authorization alone is not a confidentiality boundary.
storage_classes.protected_shareable_v1_migrate_v2: Existing encrypted representation is usable only with its documented v1 metadata leakage; migrate to ProtectedEnvelopeV2.
storage_classes.private_local: Author-local/vault-only content; no distributed cleartext representation is required.
storage_classes.opaque_public_commitment: Only a minimum opaque commitment/locator/revocation fact should be DHT-public; human-readable policy/detail remains protected.
storage_classes.split_required: One current variant mixes data with different audiences and must be split into explicitly public and protected representations.

entries.reason: Names, DOB, sex/gender, blood type, contact details, emergency contact, allergies, conditions, medications, MRN and identity linkage are PHI/PII-like data and must not rely on public-DHT storage plus coordinator read checks.

entries.current_write_state: patient-author-bound but full policy stored as public app entry
entries.reason: Issuer authority should remain verifiable while grantee, scope, purpose, exclusions, notes and relationship detail should become private/encrypted capability material plus opaque public commitments.
Requestor, requested categories, purpose, justification and urgency reveal care relationships and intent.
Detailed audit content exposes patient/accessor/category/reason/location. Publish at most opaque audit commitments; keep detailed logs available to authorized patient/auditor actors.
Reason, clinical justification, accessed categories and findings are sensitive; distributed verification needs only minimum capability/revocation evidence.
Authorization type, patient identity and signature/witness relationships require selective disclosure; a public content commitment can be separate from protected document detail.

Digest categories, accessor counts and emergency-access counts are sensitive derived metadata intended for the patient UI.

entries.current_write_state: system, organization or personal template share one entry type
entries.reason: System templates can be public, while organization/personal templates and category exclusions may encode private policy. Split by audience rather than default-public all template types.

entries.reason: Ciphertext payload is insufficient when semantic and patient metadata remains public; converge on one ProtectedEnvelopeV2 path rather than extending duplicate formats.

Patient, decryptor, entry/category, consent and purpose detail should not be network-wide audit content. Use opaque commitments plus protected detailed audit records.
Federation capability advertisement is intended for discovery; ensure identity/capability fields expose only deliberately public service metadata.
